title: Vertex operators, infinite wedge representations, and correlation functions of the t-Schur measure
summary: We study the $t$-Schur measure on partitions, defined by $ \mathbb{P}(λ)=Z^{-1}S_λ(x;t)s_λ(y) $, where $S_λ(x;t)$ denotes the $t$-Schur symmetric functions and $s_λ(y)$ the ordinary Schur functions, and $Z$ is the normalising constant. Using vertex operator calculus, we realise $S_λ(x;t)$ in the charged free-fermion Fock space, yielding a $t$-deformation of the classical boson-fermion correspondence. These realisations give vertex-algebraic proofs of the $t$-Cauchy identities and $t$-Gessel identity. Building on this framework, we compute the correlation functions of the $t$-Schur measure…
